description: Create or verify HMAC-signed JWTs (HS256 / HS384 / HS512) — for test fixtures, service-to-service tokens, webhook auth and debugging "invalid signature" errors. sign: builds header + claims with iat / exp / nbf from durations ("15m", "1h", "7d"), iss / sub / aud shortcuts and an optional random jti, and returns the compact token. verify: checks the signature in constant time plus exp / nbf / iat with leeway and optional issuer / audience expectations, and explains exactly why a token fails. The secret can be UTF-8, base64, base64url or hex; it is never echoed or stored. Warns when the secret is shorter than the hash (RFC 7518 §3.2). For RS / ES / EdDSA token decoding and JWKS verification use /v1/jwt-decode. Price: $0.002 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/jwt-sign

jti.description: sign: add a random jti (UUID v4)
